items.title: Willie J. Humphrey and Willie E. Humphrey Interview, 1959-03-15
items.q: Frankie Dusen was playing in the band at the time. And I joined up and I did real well. And then Frankie had in charge of the band, Frankie Dusen, I worked with him, I used to lead the band.

ctx.x: I heard you played with the Eagle Band once. I know.
Yeah, I played with Frankie Dusen. I played with Frankie Dusen.
Was that your first band that you played in?
